I thrive at the intersection of innovation and reliability, where my role as a DevOps engineer bridges code and infrastructure. In startups, every line of code and every system decision shapes the future—this is where I bring focus and energy. My mission is to build systems that scale with ambition, ensuring stability without sacrificing speed.  

At NexaTech Solutions, I design and maintain CI/CD pipelines that streamline deployments for our growing product suite. I own Kubernetes clusters that power our microservices architecture, optimizing resource usage and reducing downtime by 30%. My work with ArgoCD and Jenkins ensures seamless integration, while Bash scripts automate repetitive tasks, freeing teams to focus on innovation. Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana gives us real-time insights, keeping our systems reliable even under pressure.  

I’ve automated 80% of our deployment workflows, cutting release cycles by half. My contributions to scalable infrastructure have directly supported our product’s 200% growth in Q4.  

Looking ahead, I’m eager to collaborate on projects that challenge me to think bigger—whether it’s refining observability strategies or building tools that simplify complex workflows. Let’s build systems that don’t just work, but evolve with the future.
